patches.rationale: The bug: `dict(reservations)` collapses repeated SKU entries, keeping only the last quantity, so reservations for the same SKU are not summed. Fix by iterating over all reservation pairs and accumulating quantities per SKU. Unknown SKUs are naturally ignored because the result is built from `stock.items()`. Clamping at zero is preserved via `max(0, ...)`. Inputs are not mutated (we only read them). New regression tests cover repeated SKU entries, clamping, unknown SKUs, input preservation, and result types.
contract_tests: tests/test_available_units_regression.py::test_empty_inputs asserts available_units({}, []) == {} and type is dict.
tests/test_available_units_regression.py::test_inputs_not_mutated asserts stock and reservations lists/dicts are unchanged after the call, including a repeated-SKU reservation list.
tests/test_available_units_regression.py::test_result_value_types asserts all keys are str and all values are int for a repeated-SKU case.
